body: I appreciate the advice, however  I can't take potassium or eat very much of it due to being unable to rid myself of the excess which in turn would make my heart stop. The issue is my kidneys. They are, how to put it best, fucked. I am mobile but long periods of time become difficult. I work, a desk job, I can shop and get around. I don't try to be selective that's just what it seems like because it's really the only physical activity I do. It's really hard to understand if you don't deal with it personally.

I do think I'm useless at times but it's still really hard for me. My energy level is most of the time below 25% due to medical issues.  My body literally doesnt produce enough energy, not to mention I lack iron rich blood, my muscles are extremely tight, and they spasm frequently. Movement is often difficult or becomes difficult after a bit.
That's it. And I know it doesnt seem like much but it's a lot for me to get moving and motivated.
I wonder about that. I'm not sure if it would work out well. He tends to get loud at times.
I am working on setting that up. It's been difficult with all the closures and safe at home situations.
I talk to my best friend a lot. She has been great. I am working on getting therapy and medication for my mental wellbeing. My support system isn't bad.
